description: This file is a shell script used for installing host system binaries along with required libraries, including functions for copying, moving, creating directories, symlinks, and patching binaries. It manages bundling dynamic libraries and creating wrapper scripts for executables.

methods.name: _cp
methods.description: Copies files with optional verbose output, handles failure.

methods.name: _mv
methods.description: Moves files with optional verbose output, handles failure.

methods.name: _md
methods.description: Creates directories with -p option, handles failure.

methods.name: _relpath
methods.description: Calculates relative path from one directory to another.

methods.name: _runas_so
methods.description: Compiles a small shared preload library using gcc.

methods.name: _patch_ldso
methods.description: Patches the ld.so binaries to modify library paths.

methods.name: _patch_glibc
methods.description: Patches glibc locale files in binaries.

methods.name: should_be_patched
methods.description: Determines whether a binary should be patched based on its type and executability.
